I’ll double-check the clock-change dates first — quick answer: no, for any meeting in November the London time will be 2:00 PM (GMT). The UK reverted to GMT on 25 Oct 2026 and the US Eastern clocks reverted on 1 Nov 2026, so by November the offset is five hours. ([gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/when-do-the-clocks-change?hss_channel=tw-89465662&utm_source=openai))

Two-line note you can send London attendees:
- Our meeting on [DATE] at 9:00 AM ET will be at 2:00 PM in London (GMT).  
- Please let me know if you’d like me to update the calendar invite.

Confirm the exact November date (and that 9:00 AM is Eastern Time) and I’ll update the wording or produce a calendar-friendly one-liner if you prefer.
